reason: In lib/topic_retriever.rb:27-28, `$redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1")` and `$redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)` are two separate calls that are not atomic. If the process or Redis connection fails between them, `retrieved:<url>` stays with no TTL, so `retrieved_recently?` returns true forever and `retrieve` (line 9) never fetches that URL. The only exception is callers that pass `no_throttle`.
